# ESP32-C6 ChaCha20-Poly1305 open-path placement check, #275 against #280, pass 2

Second pass of the ESP32-C6 open-path placement check on the same board (MAC ending 2C:48), 2026-11-23, same images as [pass 1](../5430e8b6c600941da22ba76df8334b6a5ec1ca44-open-placement-2026-11-23/NOTES.md). The tables below are this pass's control image (`t275`); [ab.md](ab.md) has this pass's images, [ab-both-passes.md](ab-both-passes.md) both passes pooled, [RUNS.md](RUNS.md) every control run, [NOTES.md](NOTES.md) the method.

- Board: ESP32-C6 rev v0.2, 4 MB flash, USB-Serial/JTAG; the board whose MAC ends 2C:48
- CPU: Espressif ESP32-C6 (RISC-V riscv32imac), 160 MHz
- Toolchain: rustc 1.98.1 (nixpkgs), riscv32imac-unknown-none-elf, opt-level 3, lto fat, codegen-units 1
- Control image `t275`: fork #275 head at the time of the build (26-bit Poly1305 and word-XOR ChaCha20 on 32-bit targets), the earlier C6 tag run's control
- Control runs: 2 flashes (1, 3 of 3)
